statements.status_notes: CVE-2025-47909 (GHSA-82ff-hg59-8x73) exploits gorilla/csrf's schema-agnostic host comparison in the TrustedOrigins allowlist: an attacker hosting content at the http:// version of a trusted https:// origin can bypass CSRF. Harbor's csrf middleware (src/server/middleware/csrf/csrf.go at v2.15.0) calls csrf.Protect with only RequestHeader, Secure, ErrorHandler, SameSite(StrictMode), and Path options; it does not configure TrustedOrigins, so the vulnerable origin-comparison branch is never executed. No fix is available on the gorilla/csrf v1 branch; the upstream recommendation is to migrate to Go 1.25's net/http.CrossOriginProtection, which has to happen in Harbor upstream.
